boundary: Actual authenticated FastAPI ASGI, existing registry/local date_time provider/catalog and formula validator. Synthetic account and output runtime only; no external source, sample catalog fallback or physical hardware.
source_verification: Host clean exact Git HEAD/tree plus per-file SHA-256 manifest checked in container; source imported from owned worktree. Linked Git metadata is not used inside container.
enabled_provider: Checked-in date_time only; genuine current local clock values, no synthetic plugin data
array_scope: POST /displays/raw/batch is forbidden to mobile control; negative capture grants no array hydration capability
